item.title: 科研论文每日速递 | 2026-09-14 | 10 篇
item.description:
本期收录 10 篇论文。

  1. But How Would AI Agents Run a Town's Economy? — 但AI智能体将如何运行一个城镇的经济？ (78/100)
  2. R4Tun: LLM-guided adaptive segmental tunnel lining segmentation in point clouds — R4Tun：LLM引导的自适应分段隧道衬砌点云分割 (72/100)
  3. ARGOS: Who, Where, and When in Agentic Multi-Camera Person Search — ARGOS：智能体多摄像头行人搜索中的谁、何地、何时 (70/100)
  4. Event-Based De-Snowing for Autonomous Driving — 基于事件的自动驾驶去雪方法 (70/100)
  5. Reconstructing cloud-free Sentinel-2 time series under complex degradations with state-driven spatio-temporal modeling — 状态驱动时空建模下复杂退化条件的无云Sentinel-2时间序列重建 (68/100)
  6. Geospatial Foundation Models Capture Health-Relevant Dimensions of Place Beyond Conventional Social Risk Indices — 地理空间基础模型捕捉超越传统社会风险指数的健康相关场所维度 (65/100)
  7. VANTAGE-Bench: Evaluating the Infrastructure AI Gap in Vision-Language Models — VANTAGE-Bench：评估视觉语言模型中的基础设施AI差距 (65/100)
  8. Comparative Study of Anatomical and Learned Features in AI Models for Structural Brain MRI — 结构脑MRI AI模型中解剖特征与学习特征的比较研究 (65/100)
  9. NS-ST-GraphRAG: Neuro-Symbolic Spatio-Temporal GraphRAG for Literary Knowledge Processing — NS-ST-GraphRAG：用于文学知识处理的神经符号时空图RAG (65/100)
  10. Unlearning on Spatio-Temporal Graphs through Subgraph Virtual Edge Reconstruction — 通过子图虚拟边重建实现时空图上的数据遗忘 (65/100)
